title: melilotus albus var. argutus
intro: Melilotus albus var. argutus, commonly known as sweet clover, is a perennial plant in the legume family (Fabaceae) that is native to Europe and Asia. The plant is rich in isoflavones and coumarins, which have been used to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The health benefits of Melilotus albus var. argutus include its ability to act as a natural anticoagulant and to have anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to lower cholesterol levels and prevent cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of the plant include coumarin, melilotic acid, and isoflavones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as sedative and antispasmodic properties.
